stem:
Priya's school in Pune wants to manage its garden in a way that supports ecosystem health. Her teacher lists four possible practices.
For the garden to support ecosystem health, the practice must reduce pollution, protect biodiversity, keep the soil healthy, and remain sustainable over many years.
Which practice best supports ecosystem health?

options.text: Spraying chemical pesticides every week so that no insects at all are found in the garden
Replacing all the plants with one fast-growing vegetable crop to get the biggest harvest
Using compost from kitchen waste, growing a variety of local plants, and watering with collected rainwater
Burning the dry leaves and waste in the garden corner to clear the space quickly

teacher.key_rationale: Composting recycles nutrients and nourishes soil, a variety of local plants supports biodiversity, and rainwater harvesting avoids pollution and is sustainable long-term, so C meets all four checks. A kills beneficial insects and pollutes, B reduces biodiversity to a monoculture, and D causes air pollution and destroys soil organic matter.
